name: fix_node_once_listener
description: Fixes a listener that re-runs one-time setup on every 'ready' event
prompts: ConnectionPool.onFirstReady in pool.js is documented to run its setup callback exactly once, on the FIRST 'ready' event - but it registers with .on(), so every subsequent 'ready' re-runs setup and re-increments this.initialized. Fix pool.js so setup runs exactly once no matter how many 'ready' events fire (events' once() is the idiomatic tool), with this.initialized ending at 1.
